input.expected_problem: Bot may get confused by caller who changes their mind mid-conversation

conversation.content: Hello, this is Monica at Demo Clinic Alpha. How can I help you?
Hi, I think I need to schedule an appointment.
Sure! What would the appointment be for?
Actually, wait. Before I do that—do you know if my lab results are back? I had blood work last week.
I can help you check on that. Were there any specific tests done with your blood work?
Hmm, actually, I’m not sure about the specifics. I just know I had some routine tests done. Can you check if the results are back regardless? Then I'll decide about the appointment.
Got it. Let me get you to someone who can look that up for you.
Oh, wait! Before you do that, what are your hours? I need to figure out when I can come in, just in case I need to schedule an appointment.
Our office hours are Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM. We're closed on Sundays. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay, so you're open until 5. That might work. Actually, can I check on those lab results first after all? Then I'll know if I even need to come in.
I understand you're looking to check on your lab results. However, I will need to verify your identity first to access that information. Can I have your full name?
Sure! My name is Michelle Lee.
Thank you, Michelle. And what is your date of birth?
My date of birth is April 22, 1988.
I'm sorry, I wasn't able to verify your identity. Let me connect you with someone who can help.
Oh, wait! Actually, I changed my mind. I do want to schedule an appointment regardless of the lab results. Sorry, I know I'm all over the place today. Can we do that?
